name: War at Sea
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText: Keep it coming, adventurer. Us goblins don't forget that easily!
narrative.requestItemsText: You seek to befriend the goblins of Tanaris once again, adventurer? We're in need of materials for sails and guns to fight off our old enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Bring me mageweave and strong flux and we'll be on our way to pardoning your trespasses.

objectiveItems.name: Strong Flux
sources: sold by Karm Ironquill and 4 more
